whyT: Why work with a professional print lab
whyP: A print is more than a file on paper. It is a chain of decisions: paper, ink, colour, size, checking. A professional lab makes each one for your image.
why1p: Screens and papers show colour differently. We build a colour profile for each paper and print with it, so the result stays close to what you approved.
why2p: Pigment inks on papers with a manufacturer's guarantee of ageing resistance, so the print keeps its colour and its paper over time.
why3p: We review your file before printing and inspect the print afterwards. If something will not work, you hear it from us first.
why4: The right paper, the right size
why4p: A choice of papers, canvas, metal and glass, in sizes up to 70 × 150 cm, with framing through our partners.
homeT: Quality art at home and at work
homeP: The pictures around you are the ones you see every day. A well-made print gives a room character and depth that a cheap copy cannot, at home as in an office, a studio or a reception. Visitors and clients notice the care. So do you.
cmpT: Why the price reflects the quality
cmpP: A professional print costs more than a decorative poster from a home-décor store, and for good reasons. This is what the difference is made of.
cPaperB: Hahnemühle and Canon papers chosen for the image

cmpNote: A décor poster is a fair choice for a temporary room or a small budget. A MONO print is for work you want to keep.
iccP: An ICC profile describes how a paper reproduces colour on our printer. With it, you can preview your image on screen the way it will print, before you send the file.
icc1p: In Photoshop or Lightroom, choose Soft Proofing, select the profile of your paper and compare. Adjust the image if the preview shows lost detail or colour shifts.
icc2p: Profiles for our Hahnemühle Digital FineArt and Canon papers on the Canon imagePROGRAF PRO-4600.
icc3p: Ask us for the profile of your paper and we send it with the quote. Direct downloads will be added here.
